commentary: This morning, the iron ore futures conƟnued to hit new lows, with a slight rebound in the aŌernoon. The most-traded I2505 contract closed at 762, down 0.46% for the day. Traders sold according to market condiƟons; steel mills were cauƟous and observed, with moderate purchase willingness; the overall trading atmosphere was average. In Shandong, the mainstream transacƟon prices of PB ﬁnes were around 760-765 yuan/mt, basically stable compared to yesterday's prices; in Tangshan, the transacƟon prices of PB ﬁnes were around 770-772 yuan/mt, also basically stable compared to yesterday. This week, the steel industry data was released, showing that the apparent demand for the ﬁve major steel products conƟnued to grow. Inventory levels conƟnued to decline. In parƟcular, the apparent demand for rebar conƟnued to increase, with a moderate destocking rate. This provided some support to the futures market. However, there were concerns about negaƟve feedback in the market, and it was expected that ore prices would struggle to strengthen in the short term.
